_about: Voice-over for the intro video. Each line starts at 'at' seconds and must finish before 'by' (the scene's caption window in intro.html); voice.py speeds a line up a little when it would overrun. 'Pulse Edge' is spelled out so the voice says the name right.

lines.text: Hundreds of market headlines hit Indian stocks every day. Which ones matter for the stocks you own?
Pulse Edge reads every one, and gives it a label.
Act: worth reading now. Watch: keep an eye on it. Ignore: safe to skip.
Every label comes with the reason, in plain English: why it matters, and what to check.
Here's how to use it, in three steps.
First, search a company you own. You get a one-page brief: what happened, why it matters, and what could go well or wrong.
Second, add it to My stocks. That tab then shows only news about the companies you own.
Third, stuck? Ask Pulse Edge about any company, sector or market word, in your own words.
Start in Simple view, and switch to Pro any time.
Pulse Edge. Market news, sorted for the stocks you own. Try it free for five days.
